title: Men's Firefighter – Yes, One Cat. Once. Hoodie

seo.title: Firefighter Hoodie: Yes, One Cat. Once. Pullover
seo.description: A funny firefighter hoodie: a deadpan firefighter and an unimpressed cat on a ladder. 8 oz pullover, S-3XL, printed to order. Free size exchange.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

A 1950s firefighter in a helmet and turnout coat stands on a ladder against a tree and holds a very unimpressed tabby at arm's length, both of them deadpan, and the hoodie says YES, ONE CAT. ONCE. This firefighter hoodie is for the firefighter who gets asked about cats in trees at every cookout, family dinner and station open house.

The print is a 1950s fire-safety-poster scene: a man in a red helmet and red turnout coat with mustard pants and black boots balanced on a wooden ladder against a bare tree branch, holding a big striped cat with a flat stare, a few leaves drifting past. YES, ONE CAT. runs across the top in slab capitals and ONCE. below in larger red letters.

Wear it to the firehouse, the cold-weather cookout or the shift change, and give it to the firefighter who has answered the cat question one too many times. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What is the Yes, One Cat. Once. hoodie?
It is a pullover graphic hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. showing a deadpan firefighter on a ladder holding an unimpressed cat, lettered YES, ONE CAT. ONCE. It is a Gildan 18500 in 8 oz cotton-poly fleece with a double-lined hood, drawcord and front pouch pocket.

How does the pullover hoodie fit?
This Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is a classic unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL with ribbed cuffs and waistband. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up one for a roomier layer over a tee or sweater. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.

How warm is it and how do I wash it?
The hoodie is 50% pre-shrunk cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz, a solid layer for a cold station bay or a winter cookout. It is casual wear, not turnout or flame-resistant gear. Wash it inside out in cold water and tumble dry low to keep the inks bright.

Is it a good gift for a firefighter?
Yes. It suits the firefighter, the volunteer and the paramedic crew with a dry sense of humor. From Graphic Tees Co. it costs $39.99, comes in Sand and Navy, and the free size exchange makes it safe to give for a birthday, a retirement party or Christmas.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. hoodie should arrive before Christmas. Each hoodie is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
